description: Sets the four brand colours of the whole website: background, text, the button fill and the button text. Take it when the pages do not match your brand. A host says: "The buttons are still green, my brand is blue." It needs the session and the four values as hex codes like #516028. This is a change of the whole site, not of one webinar, and the webinar pages take their colours from there. It writes on your site, and the emails follow the site colours too. One setting changes only the email templates instead. Say in one sentence which of the two applies before you write, because the whole site is the bigger change. The site reads the values back, and only then is the colour really changed. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: brand colours, button colour, match my logo, colours of the page

button_fill.description: The primary and call-to-action button colour, hex.

button_text.description: The text on those buttons, hex.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

target.description: site changes the whole website and the emails, email changes only the email templates. Default site.

name: wi_change_site_colors
title: Change the brand colours of the site and the webinar pages
